text: 用不着长篇大论，一句话直击核心点：
en: No need for long speeches — one sentence hits the core point:

text: 如果你不想一辈子被人（包括但不限于媒体、组织、集体、Party）牵着鼻子走，被人当帮着数钱的煞笔…
en: If you don't want to spend your whole life being led by the nose by others (including but not limited to media, organisations, collectives, parties), being treated as the idiot who helps others count their money…

text: 那就———
en: Then ———

text: 放弃立场优先原则！
en: Abandon the stance-first principle!

text: 放弃立场优先不是叛变，不是违背信仰，不是舍弃立场。
en: Abandoning stance-first is not betrayal, not violating faith, not abandoning stance.

text: 而且把寻求事实真相作为优先考量条件。
en: It is making the search for factual truth the priority consideration.

text: 对待信息要学会先筛选平台，再多渠道求证，然后逻辑推理，最后根据你自己的认知决定选择或观望。
en: When dealing with information, learn to first filter platforms, then verify through multiple channels, then reason logically, and finally decide to choose or wait according to your own cognition.

text: 而不是一味立场至上，而掩耳盗铃，刻舟求剑，任由智商放在地上摩擦。
en: Rather than blindly putting stance above all, deceiving yourself, rigidly clinging to outdated methods, and letting your IQ be rubbed on the ground.

text: 如果你看到这里都比较认同，那我再说进阶模式：
en: If you agree with what you have read so far, let me talk about the advanced mode:

text: 不站队，做一个怀疑主义者。
en: Don't take sides; be a skeptic.

text: 不做任何人的粉（包括但不限于媒体、组织、集体、Party），不为任何事物疯狂，理智面对一切。
en: Don't be anyone's fan (including but not limited to media, organisations, collectives, parties), don't go crazy for anything, and face everything rationally.

text: 对所有信息保持怀疑，从利害关系里分析所有角色的动机。
en: Stay sceptical of all information, and analyse all roles' motives from the perspective of interests.

text: 所谓信息茧房是因为有人不愿意你知道发生了什么。
en: The so-called information cocoon exists because someone does not want you to know what happened.

text: 信息茧房太可怕了。
en: Information cocoons are too terrifying.

text: 举几个人的例子。
en: Let me give a few people's examples.

text: 一个是李隆基，一个是杨广，一个是李世民。
en: One is Li Longji, one is Yang Guang, and one is Li Shimin.

text: 当一个人身居高位，低下围满了阿谀奉承之徒，那么他就很难得知真相。
en: When a person is in a high position, surrounded below by flatterers and sycophants, it is hard for him to learn the truth.

text: 康熙微服私访不过是杜撰，被臣子们忽悠瘸了才是常态。
en: Kangxi's incognito private visits are merely fabrications; being fooled lame by his ministers is the norm.

text: 因为真实信息无法上达，必然陷入 覆舟水是苍生泪，不到横流君不知 的极端境地。
en: Because real information cannot reach the top, one inevitably falls into the extreme situation of 'the water that capsizes the boat is the tears of the common people; until the flood runs wild, the ruler does not know'.

text: 对好大喜功的李隆基而言，社会现实已经是 朱门酒肉臭路有冻死骨 了，当老大的还在那里睥睨四方洋洋自得唯我独尊不可一世笑谈宏图大业天下我有呢，殊不知转眼就是马嵬兵变。
en: For the vainglorious Li Longji, social reality was already 'behind vermilion gates, wine and meat rot, while on the road lie bones frozen to death', yet the boss was still there looking down on all sides, complacent, self-important, peerless, laughing and talking about grand plans and great causes, 'the world is mine' — little knowing that in the blink of an eye came the Mawei Mutiny.

text: 他命好，要不然就是杨广的下场“好头颅谁当取之？
en: He was lucky; otherwise it would have been Yang Guang's fate: 'A fine head — whose hands will take it?

text: 怎么办？
en: What to do?

text: 没有人是全知全能的。
en: No one is omniscient and omnipotent.

text: 每个人都能力有限。
en: Everyone has limited ability.

text: 每个人都是有局限性的。
en: Everyone has limitations.

text: 这是常识。
en: This is common sense.

text: 因此不要盲目相信自己总是对的，自己永远不会错，要学唐太宗，兼听则明偏信则暗，不要拒绝难堪没面子，否则真正丢人的在后面呢，而不是魏征的犯颜直谏下发现自己错了。
en: Therefore, don't blindly believe you are always right and will never be wrong. Learn from Emperor Taizong: listening to both sides makes one enlightened, trusting only one side makes one benighted. Don't refuse embarrassing, face-losing moments — otherwise the truly shameful thing comes later, rather than discovering you were wrong under Wei Zheng's blunt remonstrance that offended the emperor's dignity.

text: 观察者网，海外网，环球网，中国网，环球时报，环球时报新媒体，参考消息。
en: Guancha, Haiwai Net, Huanqiu, China.org.cn, Global Times, Global Times New Media, Reference News.

text: 报道的新闻，从来都是：据俄媒报道，据俄媒报道。
en: The news they report is always: 'according to Russian media reports, according to Russian media reports'.

text: 都是虚假的篡改的消息，屁股已经歪的不行了！
en: It's all false, doctored news — their bias is already beyond crooked!

text: 少上网。
en: Go online less.

text: 少上班。
en: Work less.

text: 出国去发达国家旅游，百闻不如一见，别去免签国。
en: Travel to developed countries abroad; seeing is believing — don't go to visa-free countries.

text: 但是几乎所有活在茧房里的人也办不下来签证。
en: But almost everyone living in a cocoon cannot get a visa either.

text: 打开你的上帝视角，把所有的知觉系统，丢进它的视角里，让它去观察一切，并观察你自己。
en: Open your God's-eye view, throw all your perceptual systems into its perspective, let it observe everything, and observe yourself.

text: 1.当你呱呱坠地，你便进入了一个沉浸式的游戏体验中，你的基因告诉你：饿了就哭。
en: 1. When you are born with a cry, you enter an immersive gaming experience. Your genes tell you: cry when hungry.

text: 那一刻，你因没有打开上帝视角，故而看不见自己作为一个婴儿的所有状态。
en: At that moment, because you have not opened the God's-eye view, you cannot see all your states as an infant.

text: 2.你的父母也因没有打开上帝视角，看不见自己为人父母的状态呈现，他们只能根据基因的驱动和历史经验去照顾你。
en: 2. Your parents, also because they have not opened the God's-eye view, cannot see their own states as parents. They can only care for you according to genetic drives and historical experience.

text: 比如：你一哭，他们便知道你饿了，要给你喂奶。
en: For example: as soon as you cry, they know you are hungry and need to be fed milk.

text: 3.你的父母并不懂得什么是真正的培育。
en: 3. Your parents do not understand what true nurturing is.

text: 他们不懂人类社会从农耕到手工，再进化到工业、电气乃至信息化时代。
en: They do not understand how human society evolved from farming to handicrafts, and then to industrial, electrical and even information ages.

text: 他们不懂什么叫DNA、细胞，也并不懂什么叫细胞的分裂增殖，更不懂人体的器官组织结构是如何形成的。
en: They do not understand what DNA and cells are, nor what cell division and proliferation are, let alone how the body's organ and tissue structures are formed.

text: 他们不懂力的作用，不懂天体运动，不懂什么叫原子、分子，不懂什么是化学元素周期表。
en: They do not understand the action of forces, do not understand celestial motion, do not understand what atoms and molecules are, and do not understand the periodic table of chemical elements.

text: 他们不知道什么是恒星，不知道地球所处在太阳系，不知道太阳系之外还有银河系，不知道银河系之内拥有几千亿颗恒星，也不知道银河系之外，还有10亿多个庞大的星系。
en: They do not know what stars are, do not know the Earth is in the solar system, do not know that beyond the solar system there is the Milky Way, do not know that within the Milky Way there are hundreds of billions of stars, and do not know that beyond the Milky Way there are more than a billion vast galaxies.

text: 他们不懂什么叫宇宙大爆炸，不懂什么叫第一推动力，不懂什么是质子、中子、电子、光子、中微子和夸克，更不懂什么叫作量子化和超弦。
en: They do not understand what the Big Bang is, do not understand what the first mover is, do not understand what protons, neutrons, electrons, photons, neutrinos and quarks are, let alone what quantisation and superstrings are.

text: 4.故而，你的父母并不能教你如何去理解这个世界。
en: 4. Therefore, your parents cannot teach you how to understand this world.

text: 学校可以吗？
en: Can schools?

text: 也不能。
en: No, either.

text: 因为学校在教给你这些知识的时候，并没有向你提出问题：
en: Because when schools teach you this knowledge, they do not pose the question to you:

text: 这个世界，从何而来？
en: Where did this world come from?

text: 你，又为何会存在于这个世界之中？
en: And why do you exist in this world?

text: 正是因为少问了这样的问题，所以无法引发你们的思考，更不能彻底打开你们的第三视角：上帝视角。
en: Precisely because such questions are rarely asked, they cannot trigger your thinking, let alone fully open your third perspective: the God's-eye view.

text: 5.以至于，所有人拿着这些学校所教的知识，带着一颗聪明的脑袋，跑到社会中，用它来挣钱…
en: 5. As a result, everyone takes the knowledge taught in schools, with a clever head, runs into society, and uses it to make money…

text: 6.当你打开了上帝视角，你才能真正的展开独立思考，看待任何问题，都能站在整个宇宙的立场上，去解读，去辨析。
en: 6. When you open the God's-eye view, you can truly engage in independent thinking; looking at any problem, you can stand on the position of the entire universe to interpret and distinguish.

text: 7.而当你学会用宇宙的那双眼睛去观察你自己乃至整个世界的时候，你将惊叹：
en: 7. And when you learn to use the universe's eyes to observe yourself and the entire world, you will marvel:

text: 这个世界，尽然存在着；你我他，尽然也存在着；不仅存在，尽然还能思考；不仅能思考，尽然还能通过思考，去理解这个世界。
en: This world actually exists; you, I and he actually also exist; not only do they exist, they can actually think; not only can they think, they can actually, through thinking, understand this world.

text: 8.什么是信息茧房？
en: 8. What is an information cocoon?

text: 并非你的兴趣所涉猎的范围，才是茧房。
en: It is not the range covered by your interests that is the cocoon.

text: 而是无法突破生死线段，触达生死之外的一切信息，皆是茧房。
en: Rather, whatever cannot break through the life-death line segment and reach everything beyond life and death is a cocoon.

text: 9.一个生命，倘若无法突破生死观，那么这个生命的视线范围，将永远被局限于生死之内。
en: 9. If a life cannot break through its view of life and death, then that life's field of vision will forever be confined within life and death.

text: 卸载一切app。
en: Uninstall all apps.

text: 每天看：新闻联播，人民日报，参考消息。
en: Watch every day: News Broadcast, People's Daily, Reference News.

text: 1、可以考虑刻意留下脏信息。
en: 1. You can consider deliberately leaving dirty information.

text: 用于污染自己的用户画像。
en: Used to pollute your user profile.

text: 脏信息的选取要选大点、热点，不能太偏门。
en: Dirty information should be chosen big and hot, not too obscure.

text: 比如要在B站混入脏信息，可以找“京阿尼”、“学日语”、“观察者网”这些热门内容。
en: For example, to mix dirty information into Bilibili, you can look for hot content like 'Kyoto Animation', 'learning Japanese', 'Guancha'.

text: 然后跟着相关推荐多点几次，持续几天就能让APP误以为你真的喜欢这些内容。
en: Then follow related recommendations and click a few more times; after a few days, the app will mistakenly think you really like this content.

text: 脏信息最好能形成脏画像。
en: Dirty information is best formed into a dirty profile.

text: 偶尔几个脏信息起到的效果比较一般，但如果这几个脏信息能组合成某个画像，起到的混淆效果就能倍增。
en: Occasionally a few pieces of dirty information have mediocre effect, but if these pieces of dirty information can combine into a profile, the confusion effect can multiply.

text: 最好是和自己画像完全相反。
en: Best if it is completely opposite to your own profile.

text: 女生可以用数码、游戏等混淆。
en: Girls can use digital products, games, etc. to confuse.

text: 男生可以用女生的三大坑混淆。
en: Boys can use girls' three big pits to confuse.

text: 年轻人可以用股票、足球等混淆。
en: Young people can use stocks, football, etc. to confuse.

text: 2、有精神洁癖、对艺术有矜持感的，就尽量远离热门、主流的作品。
en: 2. Those with mysophobia and a sense of restraint towards art should stay away from popular, mainstream works as much as possible.

text: 同时也要小心热门的漩涡。
en: At the same time, beware of the vortex of popularity.

text: 任何一个轻百合作品都有可能拐到轻音，然后拐到山田尚子、拐到CLANNAD等时泪，最后让京阿尼占领你的首页，比如最近的《孤独摇滚》，就有很大往轻音拐的趋势。
en: Any light yuri work could lead you to K-On!, then to Naoko Yamada, then to CLANNAD and other tearjerkers, and finally let Kyoto Animation occupy your homepage — for example, the recent Bocchi the Rock! shows a strong trend towards K-On!.

text: 动漫远离京阿尼、新海诚、大V的新番漫评。
en: For anime, stay away from Kyoto Animation, Makoto Shinkai, and big-V new-season anime reviews.

text: 小说远离东野圭吾。
en: For novels, stay away from Keigo Higashino.

text: 当个矜持的婆罗门，是避免信息茧房的好办法。
en: Being a reserved Brahmin is a good way to avoid information cocoons.

text: 3、一些与主流相悖的圈子其实可以不畏惧信息茧房。
en: 3. Some circles that go against the mainstream actually need not fear information cocoons.

text: 与主流相悖的信息不太可能会频繁推荐。
en: Information that goes against the mainstream is unlikely to be frequently recommended.

text: 比如百合作品，现在主流价值观对女孩子之间的爱情是反对态度的，平台方一般会限流这类内容。
en: For example, for yuri works, mainstream values now oppose love between girls, and platforms generally restrict the traffic of such content.

text: 大胆的去点这类内容也不会让你的首页被占领。
en: Boldly clicking such content will not let your homepage be occupied.

text: 4、相似推荐算法主要是依赖“特征-标签”体系。
en: 4. Similar recommendation algorithms mainly rely on a 'feature-tag' system.

text: 在浏览信息的时候，可以下意识的自行分辨一下这个信息的标签，下次遇到可能是相同标签的作品时可以少点。
en: When browsing information, you can subconsciously distinguish the tags of this information yourself, and when you encounter works that may have the same tags next time, click less.

text: 其实我很反感别人给我贴标签，很多时候贴的标签都不对。
en: Actually, I really dislike others labelling me; often the labels are wrong.

text: 比如下图这首曲子是《近月少女的礼仪》里的BGM，是比较舒缓、令人安心的曲子。
en: For example, the piece in the picture below is the BGM from Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou — a relatively soothing, reassuring piece.

text: 然而网易云给它贴的标签是“朋克、新世纪”。
en: However, NetEase Cloud Music labels it as 'punk, new age'.

text: 我不太懂什么是新世纪，但这首曲子绝对和朋克不沾边。
en: I don't quite understand what new age is, but this piece is definitely not punk.
